title: Anais in Love (bcSunday)
synopsis:
Anais in Love, a buoyant French comedy from director Charline Bourgeois-Tacquet, a tale of self-discovery as literate and delightful as it is unexpected, keeping both Anaïs and viewers off-balance until the very last moment.

 

A spirited and romantic thirtysomething Anaïs in her manic search for stability. Behind on her rent, contemplating breaking up with her boyfriend, and struggling to complete her thesis, Anaïs searches for inspiration while hurtling through lovers with abandon. When her affair with an older book publisher Daniel leads to her falling for his live-in partner Emilie, a brilliant and luminescent novelist, things get especially messy.
